lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Long ago, a proud king declared that the *moon* belonged to him.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Anyone who walked in its light had to pay him a *coin*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: One night, a little girl named Mira stood before him.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Then the moon owes *me*, king. It followed me all the way home!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The king looked up. He could not make the moon *stop*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So the tax ended. And the moon still walks everyone home, for *free*.
